build_vip_package: build the vip python package using setuptools with find_packages and install_requires
read_readme_file: read the README.md file from the project root directory for long_description
check_python_version: check that the running Python interpreter is version 3 before installation proceeds
install_vip_dependencies: install vip package dependencies including torch, torchvision, omegaconf, hydra-core, and wandb
find_vip_packages: find all python packages in the vip project directory using setuptools find_packages
